student_learning_goal: I can describe positions and movements on a map.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can describe positions and movements on a map.
header.character_watermark: Symmy and Flippy in capes in the top-right. Small (~1.5in combined). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Count sides + lines of symmetry for 3 shapes.
parts.visual_layout: 3 shapes with table for sides and symmetry lines.

image_placeholders.description: 3 shapes for Grade 2 capstone worksheet, B&W line art. Square, equilateral triangle, regular hexagon. Each ~1.5in. Below: table 'Shape | Sides | Symmetry'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_SHAPES at Part 1: keywords name the attributes.

parts.student_instructions: Match 3 pairs as congruent or NOT.

image_placeholders.description: 3 pair rows for Grade 2 capstone, B&W line art. Each row: 2 shapes + checkboxes 'CONGRUENT' / 'NOT'. Pairs: same triangles, different sized squares, same rectangles (one rotated).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_CONGRUENT at Part 2: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Same triangles: CONGRUENT. Different squares: NOT. Same rectangles: CONGRUENT.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the maze. Write 3 directions to navigate from START to GOAL.

image_placeholders.description: A maze grid for Grade 2 capstone, B&W line art. ~5in × 3in. 6×4 squares. START at bottom-left with star icon. GOAL at top-right with chest icon. Path squares visible. Below: 3 numbered direction lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_MAZE at Part 3: keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Any valid 3-direction sequence (e.g., 'forward 5, turn right, forward 3') reaching the goal.

parts.part_title: Part 4: AREA — same tiles, two ways.
parts.student_instructions: Show 6 tiles rearranged two ways. Circle that the area = 6 in BOTH.
parts.visual_layout: Two boxes labelled 'Way 1' and 'Way 2'; below each, the prompt 'area = ___' for the child to fill in 6.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the top-down map. Circle the symbol that matches the bedroom door. Write one position-word sentence about another symbol.
parts.visual_layout: Small top-down bedroom map with bed, desk, door, window. Three blank lines for the position-word sentence.
parts.answer_key: Sample: 'The desk is BETWEEN the bed and the window.' Accept any valid position-word sentence.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write directions BACKWARDS (GOAL to START).
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone — summative. Score against the rubric. Look for: shape attributes (E1.1), congruence (E1.3), maze directions verb+number (E1.5). Parts added to capture E1.2 (area conservation) and E1.4 (map reading) — summative artefact now includes all 4 lesson skills.
